source.name: Childs-Su-Tran-Wiebe-Zhu, A Theory of Trotter Error

sector: one excitation on an open even-length chain

split.onsite: Delta times identity in the one-excitation sector and therefore commutes with A and B
split.commutatorNorm: ||[A,B]||=2 t^2 cos[pi/(M/2+1)] for even M divisible by four

designDecision.shortTime: first-order brickwork is a finite commissioning path
designDecision.longTime: the conservative gate count exceeds one million at the strongest 744-cell benchmark, selecting native analog exchange, free-fermion/matchgate compilation, or a higher-order product formula
designDecision.heldOutCheck: compare measured digital error against the commutator bound as the step number is doubled

established: an explicit one-excitation even-odd commutator and conservative first-order Trotter resource budget for the selective exchange lane
boundary: The norm and budget apply only to the one-excitation sector. Many-excitation operator norms, hardware gate error, higher-order formulas and analog exchange require separate analyses; the bound is sufficient and need not be tight.
